function: Energy-efficiency maximization of a PIN-diode RIS (power allocation and discrete phase shifts) by an iterative cross-entropy sampling optimizer run per channel; no trained model (p. 3).
notes: Excluded (no_learning). The 'probability learning-based algorithm' is the cross-entropy method, an iterative sampling optimizer: 'The CEO framework is an iterative method that employs tilting parameters' (p. 3). Its probability matrix Q is re-estimated from elite samples at each iteration for the given channels (Eqs. 9-11, p. 3; Algorithms 2-3, p. 4). There is no trained model, training data or inference stage; it is compared with the SDR, MGS and SRA optimizers and a random RIS (p. 4). The system is a PIN-diode RIS with 1-2 bit phases in MU-MISO (p. 2).
